description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing wpa_ctrl sockets used for communication with hostapd/wpa_supplicant daemons, including connection, disconnection, request handling, and event subscription. It also manages multiple interface connections via a client class.

classes.name: wpa_ctrl_socket
classes.description: Abstract base class for wpa_ctrl socket connections, providing methods to connect, disconnect, open, close, and access socket properties.

classes.name: wpa_ctrl_socket_cmd
classes.description: Derived class for sending commands and receiving synchronous replies over a wpa_ctrl socket.

classes.name: wpa_ctrl_socket_event
classes.description: Derived class for receiving unsolicited events from the daemon, managing subscription and data reception.

classes.name: wpa_ctrl_client
classes.description: Manages multiple interface connections to hostapd/wpa_supplicant, handling command and event sockets for each registered interface.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the current socket file descriptor.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the daemon (implemented in derived classes).

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the daemon (implemented in derived classes).

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a command and waits for a synchronous reply.

methods.name: pending
methods.description: Checks if there is pending data to read.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Reads available data from the socket.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Subscribes the socket to receive events.

methods.name: add_interface
methods.description: Registers a new interface with command and event sockets.

methods.name: del_interface
methods.description: Unregisters an interface and cleans resources.

methods.name: has_interface
methods.description: Checks if an interface is registered.

methods.name: get_socket_cmd
methods.description: Retrieves the command socket for an interface.

methods.name: get_socket_event
methods.description: Retrieves the event socket for an interface.

methods.name: get_socket_event (by fd)
methods.description: Retrieves the event socket by file descriptor.

methods.name: get_interface
methods.description: Returns interface name associated with a socket file descriptor.
